title: style › Themes: picking another theme really changes the deck theme (colours differ) on every slide
style › Fonts: choosing a heading font changes theme.fonts.heading and the rendered title font
style › Colors: slide background swatch sets that slide's background to exactly that colour
style › Layout alternatives: choosing a design changes the slide layout and keeps its text
format › size ±, bold, align, colour each change the saved element
slides › duplicate copies the content; move up/down reorders; delete removes exactly that slide
slides › a new layout slide (Comparison) arrives with real placeholder content, not empty frames
insert › text box / rectangle / circle land INSIDE the slide with the right type
notes › speaker notes typed in the editor are saved on that slide only
AI › "change the colours" changes theme.colors in the saved doc and says so; Undo restores
AI › "animate every slide" sets theme.motion (entrance not none)
AI › slide scope "make this slide much shorter": that slide shrinks, others untouched
AI › quick action Expand makes the slide longer (not a no-op)
AI › "translate this slide to Spanish" really produces Spanish
AI › locked slide is refused honestly and stays untouched
present mode shows the CURRENT content of the slide (not a stale copy)
everything above persisted: reload shows the same slide count and the same AI-edited text
